ophytrack_public.meta_title: OPHYTRACK | Logistics, package tracking and delivery control
ophytrack_public.meta_description: Connect orders, inventory, warehouses, carriers, drivers and customers with package-level traceability from sale to proof of delivery.
ophytrack_public.signup_subtitle: Start as a seller, store or carrier. Configure the operation your organization actually runs.
ophytrack_public.hero_title: Every package. Every handoff. One source of truth.
ophytrack_public.hero_lead: Run store orders, fulfillment, carrier custody, warehouse sorting and last-mile delivery in one connected operation.
ophytrack_public.core_title: The operational depth your logistics network needs
ophytrack_public.core_lead: Replace disconnected spreadsheets, messages and status updates with a shared package record that follows the physical operation.
ophytrack_public.orders_text: Create products and manual orders, record payments, publish payment links and synchronize external sales channels.
ophytrack_public.warehouse_text: Receive, scan, classify and locate packages while preserving the responsible organization, user and evidence at every handoff.
ophytrack_public.delivery_text: Give drivers a mobile workflow for routes, incidents, retries, recipient validation, photos and final proof of delivery.
ophytrack_public.flow_title: From checkout to delivery, without blind spots
ophytrack_public.flow_lead: Each milestone adds an immutable event to the package timeline.
ophytrack_public.step_1_text: Create or import the order, validate payment and generate a secure package identifier and printable QR label.
ophytrack_public.step_2_text: Assign the preparation team, validate stock and leave the package ready for pickup or an in-house driver.
ophytrack_public.step_3_text: A valid QR can record immediate custody; a manual-code request remains subject to seller approval.
ophytrack_public.step_4_text: Confirm warehouse reception with evidence, then organize by region, route, priority and promised date.
ophytrack_public.step_5_text: Track departure, delivery attempts, customer absence, rejection, incidents and scheduled retries.
ophytrack_public.step_6_text: Close with recipient proof or continue through reverse custody, seller decision, restocking and refund.
ophytrack_public.roles_title: One package record. A focused workspace for every role.
ophytrack_public.seller_text: Own the commercial relationship, inventory, payment, preparation and carrier assignment while retaining end-to-end visibility.
ophytrack_public.carrier_text: Operate independent hubs and teams, accept authorized custody and coordinate collection, sorting and dispatch.
ophytrack_public.driver_text: Scan, navigate, call, chat and register every outcome from a mobile-first delivery workspace.
ophytrack_public.customer_text: Follow purchases, payments, delivery attempts, approved evidence, returns and seller decisions without seeing internal notes.
ophytrack_public.trust_title: Every movement has an owner, a place and a reason
ophytrack_public.trust_text: OPHYTRACK ties each status to the authorized company, responsible user, timestamp, location, source, notes and photographic evidence when required.
ophytrack_public.trust_owner_text: Seller, carrier, workspace and customer boundaries are verified on the server.
ophytrack_public.trust_history_text: Custody events preserve the package story instead of replacing the previous status.
ophytrack_public.trust_exceptions_text: Absence, rejection, cancellation, return, refund and redelivery stay in the same timeline.
ophytrack_public.integrations_title: Bring external orders into the same operation
ophytrack_public.integrations_text: Connect Shopify, Mercado Libre and TikTok Shop through owner-scoped connectors, manual sync, webhooks and scheduled synchronization.
ophytrack_public.carrier_cta_title: Are you a carrier? Your logistics workspace is included.
